draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.83, the 205th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 14th of 16 at TE. He went 171st overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (205th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (6th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (6th percentile). College production: 560 receiving yards in 2022, 5th of 16 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. 46 career games and 18 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2023. Weak spots: receiving yards 11 (5th percentile), approximate value 0 (9th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 tight end who played: 11 receiving yards against a median of 196, below the norm.
